info.description: The header and footer navigation, and any scripts injected into every page such as a tag manager. Changing this affects every page on the site.

favicon.description: The icon browsers show on the tab and in bookmarks. An SVG is sharpest and scales to every size; a square PNG of at least 180x180 also works. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the site.

headScripts.description: Raw markup injected at the end of <head> on every page, e.g. the Google Tag Manager snippet.

bodyScripts.description: Raw markup injected immediately after <body> opens, e.g. the GTM noscript iframe.
